title: POI Descriptions upstream 200 documented-shape schema
description: All fetched reference 200 field paths are represented; guide-only Context metadata is added. Unknown properties are allowed, and optional reference fields allow null. Requiredness is intentionally not enforced because these are variable vendor models, not exhaustive validation.

type.description: Vendor field; semantic details/units are not specified in the fetched reference.
Documented discriminator `local_description` identifies this enclosing model; unknown future tags remain accepted.

id.description: Identifier scoped to the enclosing result; local-place IDs expire in about eight hours.

description.description: Display description/excerpt; POI Descriptions text is generated and Context source description is query-independent.
